limites: DECLARED COLLECTION ASYMMETRY: on 14/09/2026 items were added to the lists of Pablo Marçal (2005 criminal case, Pico dos Marins, Celso Guimarães Silva case, Bruno da Silva Teixeira case) and of Renan Santos (Betim labor enforcement proceedings, lawsuit over the publication of PGFN debts, the companies' labor liabilities), as well as a financing item in the Missão party block. All of them came from material brought in after the original collection and widen the scope beyond what was applied to the other six candidacies, whose sweep prioritized electoral cases and did not cover labor lawsuits against companies, enforcement proceedings, tax debts or police investigations without charges. Until the same widened sweep is repeated for all of them, the lists for Marçal and for Renan Santos are more complete than the others, and the difference in the size of the lists must NOT be read as a difference in conduct.

The collection used only WebSearch and WebFetch (with no direct access to curl/wget/requests); it was not possible to consult directly the case-tracking systems of the STF, STJ and TSE (which require a case number or CPF in an interactive form), only those courts' institutional news pages and press reports citing case numbers.

Several cases mentioned in the press were left out of this list because it was not possible to confirm, from the sources read, whether the person is formally a party (defendant/person under investigation) or whether the case is proceeding only against third parties, subordinates or the government/administration in general (e.g.: part of the coverage of Ronaldo Caiado's administration in Goiás deals with administrative contracts without naming the governor as personally under investigation).

For Augusto Cury, there are reports about a civil collection action for default on a health insurance plan and about the omission of companies in the United States from a declaration to the Electoral Court; neither of the two was included because there is no confirmation of a formal case at the STF/STJ/TSE/TRE and no ruling on the merits widely documented in more than one editorial line — see the person's 'obs' field.

For Renan Santos, a news report from September 2026 shows him asking the STF for access to decisions in the fake news police investigation and in the INSS case; it was not clear, from the sources read, whether he is under investigation in those police investigations or merely an interested party requesting transparency, so the item was not included.

Start dates for some of the older cases (2010s) were obtained only in approximate form (month/year) when the source did not give the exact date on which the police investigation was opened or the indictment was accepted; in those cases the 'inicio' field records the most precise month/year found.
Several cases are still pending as of the date of the collection (13/09/2026); the status recorded reflects the last documented decision up to that date, which may already have changed.

It was not possible, for all items, to find two press sources of different editorial orientation covering exactly the same fact; where that happened, the item was kept (because it came from an official court source or an official news agency, or because there was no reason to doubt the account), but the limitation was noted in the 'obs' field of the case or of the person.

In this round (classification of conclusion/outcome and search for new cases), the 'conclusao' field follows a closed vocabulary of 5 labels defined by the requester; cases of summary rejection of an indictment/private criminal complaint (before any evidentiary phase) were classified as 'no ruling on the merits', and not as acquittal, even when the decision discussed, in passing, the absence of criminal conduct.

For the case 'AIJE — events at the Palácio das Esmeraldas' (Ronaldo Caiado), the source consulted does not make clear whether the upheld conviction (a fine of R$ 60,000) still allows an ordinary appeal beyond the one already ruled on by the TRE-GO on 8/4/2025, or whether that second decision is already the last one at the state level before the TSE; the 'conclusao' field was recorded as 'convicted, appeal available' out of caution.

For the two items of disapproved accounts of Avante (TRE-RO and TRE-SP) and for the PRTB item, the press/court sources consulted do not always explicitly confirm whether an appeal is available; where the source did not state this, 'convicted, appeal available' was adopted by default, since the disapproval of party accounts is, as a rule, appealable to the TSE — but this was not read, case by case, in all the sources.

It was not possible to confirm, with the sources read in this collection, any pending electoral case (AIJE — electoral investigation action, representation, request for revocation or for ineligibility) brought specifically against Augusto Cury, Rui Costa Pimenta or Romeu Zema beyond the cases already listed for each of them; the absence of a result may reflect a limit of the search (WebSearch/WebFetch), not necessarily the nonexistence of the case.

For the Partido Novo, no case was found (rejected accounts, fine, questioned use of the Fundo Partidário/Eleitoral, action about gender/race quotas or request for revocation of registration) in which the national party is a party to the proceedings, within the limits of this collection; this is recorded as 'nada_localizado' and must not be read as proof of nonexistence.

The official pages of the TRE-SP (tre-sp.jus.br) frequently returned empty content to WebFetch in this collection (possible blocking of automated tools), which limited direct checking of some news items about the disapproval of the accounts of state party branches (e.g.: accounts of the PT, of the PSD and other items of Avante and of the PCO mentioned in searches but not confirmed by direct reading); in those cases, the item was not included in this update.

The action for abuse of economic power involving Lula and a carnival parade, cited as an example by the requester, was confirmed to be real: it is AIJE (electoral investigation action) 0601427-66.2026.6.00.0000, brought by the Novo party (and not by Flávio Bolsonaro) against the Lula-Alckmin ticket, admitted by the TSE on 26/8/2026 and still with no ruling on the merits; it was included in the list of Lula's cases.

Pablo Marçal: the 2005 criminal case (Operação Pegasus) was included on 14/09/2026, after the original collection, on the basis of the TRF-1 ruling in PDF and of press coverage. It was not in the first collection, which prioritized recent electoral cases — the absence was a failure of scope, not an editorial decision.

Pablo Marçal: three non-electoral cases (Pico dos Marins, the death of Celso Guimarães Silva and the death of Bruno da Silva Teixeira) were included on 14/09/2026, also after the original collection. Two of them are not criminal cases against him: one is a labor lawsuit against a company in which he is a partner, the other is a police investigation with no formal charges — the conclusion labels say so item by item.

processos.titulo: Rachadinhas case (Alerj)
processos.objeto: Investigated an alleged scheme to divert part of the salaries of aides in Flávio Bolsonaro's office at the Rio de Janeiro Legislative Assembly (Alerj), between 2007 and 2018, when he was a state deputy.
processos.resumo: The case went through phases in which the banking and tax secrecy of the then state deputy was lifted, later annulled by the STJ, and the STF upheld the senator's privileged jurisdiction and held inadmissible certain financial intelligence reports used as evidence (November 2021). In May 2022, the Criminal Section of the TJ-RJ shelved the indictment at the request of Rio's own Ministério Público, which acknowledged that there was no longer valid evidence to sustain the case. The MP-RJ recorded that the investigation could, in theory, be reopened with new requests to lift secrecy.
processos.desfecho: There was no acquittal: the MP-RJ requested that the case be shelved, finding that the evidence obtained was invalid, and the case could in theory be reopened.

processos.titulo: Police investigation into the funding of the documentary 'Dark Horse'
processos.objeto: Investigates whether Flávio Bolsonaro negotiated directly with former banker Daniel Vorcaro (Banco Master) the funding of a documentary about Jair Bolsonaro, in possible money laundering, illegal foreign exchange remittance and corruption schemes.
processos.resumo: Justice André Mendonça authorized, on July 22, 2026, the opening of a police investigation at the request of the Polícia Federal to look into the financing of the documentary 'Dark Horse' through Banco Master. Reports from September 2026 identify Flávio Bolsonaro as a formal target of the investigation, citing amounts between about US$ 12.3 million and R$ 60 million in transfers from Vorcaro related to the project. The police investigation remains under seal and active as of the collection date.
processos.desfecho: It is a sealed police investigation opened at the PF's request; up to the date of the collection, no one had been indicted or become a defendant in this case.

processos.titulo: Action for abuse of economic power — rally at the Festa de Barretos
processos.objeto: Electoral action brought by Lula's campaign alleging abuse of economic power and improper use of the structure of the Festa de Barretos (funded with around R$ 30 million in public and private money) to promote Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-candidacy on August 22, 2026.
processos.resumo: The action was admitted by the Electoral Court on September 7, 2026. Lula's campaign asks for the revocation of Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy and for his ineligibility, alleging that he took the stage at concerts and used the structure of the event for campaign purposes. As of the collection date, Bolsonaro's defense had not yet been filed and there is no ruling on the merits. In a further decision, the TSE's Corregedoria-Geral Eleitoral ordered the inquiry to proceed, with a five-day deadline for the defense; the report consulted is explicit in stating that 'there is no decision that there was any irregularity'.
processos.desfecho: The action was admitted and remains under investigation at the TSE, which ordered the case to proceed; there is no decision on whether there was abuse of economic power.

bol.obs: Há ainda notícia (30-31/08/2026) de que a coligação de Lula pediu ao TSE a impugnação do registro de candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro; não foi possível abrir a fonte original (bloqueio de robots.txt) para confirmar se se trata do mesmo processo do item Barretos ou de uma ação distinta, por isso não foi incluída separadamente. Além disso, buscou-se confirmar a ação por abuso de poder econômico envolvendo Lula e o desfile de carnaval da Acadêmicos de Niterói citada como exemplo: trata-se de ação real, movida pelo partido Novo (não por Flávio Bolsonaro) contra Lula, incluída no registro de Lula nesta atualização (AIJE 0601427-66.2026.6.00.0000).

processos.titulo: Private criminal complaint by Valter Casimiro (statements about a 'mafia-like structure')
processos.objeto: Private criminal complaint for slander, defamation and insult filed by the then Secretary of Government of the Distrito Federal, Valter Casimiro Silveira, against Ronaldo Caiado, over statements given in a TV interview calling public transportation in the area around Brasília a 'mafia-like structure' and associating the secretary with 'shady dealings'.
processos.resumo: The Special Court of the STJ unanimously rejected the private criminal complaint against the governor of Goiás. The reporting justice, Nancy Andrighi, held that Caiado did not attribute a specific and verifiable fact to Casimiro, this being generic criticism protected by freedom of expression, without sufficient elements to characterize a crime against honor.
processos.obs: The two press sources located have a similar editorial orientation (center); no coverage of the fact in outlets of a different orientation was found within the time frame of this collection.
processos.desfecho: The STJ rejected the private criminal complaint before any evidentiary phase, finding that the statement did not attribute a specific fact; there was no case and no ruling on the merits.

processos.titulo: Administrative improbity action — expanded police escort
processos.tribunal: 2nd State Public Treasury Court of Goiás
processos.objeto: Public civil action for administrative improbity brought by the Ministério Público de Goiás against Ronaldo Caiado, Maria das Graças ('Gracinha') Caiado and the then head of the Casa Militar, for the expansion of the military police escort (from 4 to 51 officers) to protect the former governor and family members after he left office, at an alleged monthly cost of R$ 797,500.
processos.resumo: The action, brought by prosecutor Leila Maria de Oliveira, alleges illicit enrichment and harm to public funds arising from an ordinance signed on April 1, 2026 (one day after Caiado left the state government to run for President) that extended the security escort to family members. On July 6, 2026, judge Vinícius Caldas da Gama e Abreu granted an injunction limiting the escort to four police officers in total. As of the collection date no ruling on the merits of the action was found, only the injunction; for that reason the status is recorded as not confirmed as to the merits.
processos.desfecho: There is only an injunction reducing the escort; the administrative improbity action is still ongoing and there had been, up to the collection, no ruling on illicit enrichment.

processos.titulo: AIJE — events at the Palácio das Esmeraldas in support of Sandro Mabel (Goiânia municipal election, 2024)
processos.objeto: Electoral investigation action (AIJE) brought by the defeated candidate Fred Rodrigues (PL) examining whether Ronaldo Caiado used the seat of the Goiás state government (Palácio das Esmeraldas) and public employees, at two events decorated in the campaign colors, to promote Sandro Mabel's candidacy for mayor of Goiânia in 2024.
processos.status: condenado em primeira instância, decisão parcialmente revertida em recurso
processos.resumo: The TRE-GO convicted Caiado and Mabel on December 11, 2024, imposing on Caiado eight years of ineligibility and a fine of R$ 60,000, and revoking Mabel's mandate. On April 8, 2025, the court reversed the ineligibility, holding that the use of public employees during working hours did not amount to an abuse of political power sufficient to affect the result of the election, but upheld the R$ 60,000 fine on Caiado. The decision may still be challenged at the TSE.
processos.desfecho: The TRE-GO convicted Caiado in December 2024, but in April 2025 it lifted the ineligibility, keeping only the R$ 60,000 fine; the decision can still be challenged at the TSE.

cai.obs: Não foram localizados, nas fontes consultadas, processos pessoais contra Caiado em tramitação no STF ou no TSE/TRE até a data da coleta; reportagens sobre pagamentos do governo de Goiás a empresas ligadas ao PCC e sobre a Operação Overclean tratam de contratos da administração estadual, sem que as fontes lidas indiquem Caiado pessoalmente como investigado, por isso não foram incluídas.

cur.obs: Nenhum processo ou inquérito no STF, STJ, TSE ou TRE, nem decisão de mérito amplamente documentada em outra instância, foi localizado envolvendo Augusto Cury como parte, dentro dos limites desta coleta (busca e leitura via WebSearch/WebFetch). Foram encontradas duas reportagens que não atendem aos critérios de inclusão: (1) uma coluna da Metrópoles menciona que Cury é réu em ação civil de cobrança por inadimplência de plano de saúde — processo civil rotineiro, sem tribunal superior envolvido e sem decisão de mérito amplamente documentada; (2) reportagens de 5-6/09/2026 (O Tempo/Diário do Grande ABC/Rádio Pampa, todas de cobertura semelhante) afirmam que Cury omitiu empresas nos EUA e propriedades rurais em sua declaração à Justiça Eleitoral, mas nenhuma delas registra a abertura de processo formal (ação de impugnação, investigação do TSE) até a data da coleta — a campanha de Cury respondeu que corrigiria eventual inconsistência pontual. Nesta atualização, buscou-se especificamente por ações eleitorais (AIJE, representações, pedidos de cassação ou inelegibilidade) contra Augusto Cury; não foi localizada nenhuma ação dessa natureza em tramitação contra ele.

processos.titulo: Criminal case from Operação Pegasus — aggravated theft by bank fraud (2005)
processos.tribunal: 11th Federal Court of Goiânia (federal justice system) · appeal at the TRF-1
processos.objeto: Criminal case arising from Operação Pegasus, of the Polícia Federal, concerning a gang that captured banking data through malicious software and diverted money from accounts. Marçal, then 18 years old, was identified in the indictment as responsible for maintaining the group's computers and for collecting email addresses of potential victims. He was the target of a temporary arrest in 2005 — detention for investigation, not the serving of a sentence.
processos.resumo: The first-instance judgment, published on 05/05/2010, convicted Marçal of aggravated theft (art. 155, §4º, of the Código Penal) as a continuing offense, recognizing participation of minor importance; the press records a sentence of 4 years and 5 months of imprisonment. He appealed. Before ruling on the merits of the appeal, the TRF-1 declared punishability extinguished by retroactive statute of limitations on the right to prosecute: since Marçal was under 21 on the date of the events (born on 18/04/1987), the limitation period is cut in half, and more time had already passed than the law allows since the judgment was published. The ruling was published on 20/10/2017; much of the press dates the outcome as 2018. Marçal has never served a sentence for this case.

fonte.nome: Acórdão do TRF-1 no processo (íntegra em PDF)

processos.desfecho: There was a conviction at first instance, but it never became final: the court recognized the statute of limitations before ruling on the appeal. Because it is a statute of limitations on the right to prosecute, the law requires the conviction to produce no effect at all — it does not count as a criminal record and does not create ineligibility. Nor is it an acquittal: the appeal was never ruled on the merits, and no court said that he did not do what the indictment described. Marçal maintains that he only repaired computers and knew nothing of the scheme; the 2010 judgment rejected that account.
processos.obs: Discrepancy recorded: the ruling that was read mentions a sentence of 5 years and 6 months of imprisonment and 111 day-fines, while the press attributes 4 years and 5 months to Marçal. It was not possible to confirm, in the full text read, whether the higher figure refers to him or to another defendant in the same case, which is why both figures appear here.

processos.titulo: AIJE — abuse of power and improper use of media (Bela Vista Electoral District)
processos.objeto: Electoral Judicial Investigation Action (AIJE) that investigated abuse of political and economic power and improper use of the mass media by Pablo Marçal in the campaign for mayor of São Paulo in 2024.
processos.resumo: The 1st Electoral Zone (Bela Vista) had sentenced Marçal to eight years of ineligibility. On August 25, 2026, the TRE-SP reversed that conviction by 5 votes to 1, finding the action unfounded for lack of elements that would characterize abuse of power or improper use of the media.

fonte.nome: Tribunal Regional Eleitoral de São Paulo (TRE-SP)

processos.desfecho: The TRE-SP reversed the first-instance conviction and ruled the action unfounded by 5 votes to 1; Lula's coalition can still appeal to the TSE.

processos.titulo: AIJE — alleged sale of support to city council candidates
processos.objeto: Electoral Judicial Investigation Action (AIJE) that investigated an alleged sale of political support by Pablo Marçal to city council candidates in the São Paulo municipal election of 2024.
processos.resumo: The TRE-SP reversed, on November 6, 2025, the first-instance conviction that had declared Marçal ineligible in this case. The motions for clarification against that reversal were rejected on February 4, 2026. The case awaits, as of the collection date, a ruling on a special appeal by the TSE.

fonte.nome: Tribunal Regional Eleitoral de São Paulo (TRE-SP)

processos.desfecho: The TRE-SP also reversed this conviction for abuse, but the decision is not final: the case awaits judgment of a special appeal by the TSE.

processos.titulo: AIJE — 'clip contest' with cash prizes on social media
processos.objeto: Electoral Judicial Investigation Action (AIJE) that investigates the promotion, by Pablo Marçal, of a contest of short videos ('cortes') on social media with promises of cash prizes tied to the performance of the content, during the São Paulo municipal campaign in 2024.
processos.resumo: Marçal was convicted in February 2025 of abuse of political and economic power. The TRE-SP upheld the eight-year ineligibility (until 2032) in a decision of December 4, 2025, confirmed unanimously after the rejection of the motion for clarification on August 5, 2026. The case awaits an appeal to the TSE, which had not ruled on the merits as of the collection date.

fonte.nome: Tribunal Regional Eleitoral de São Paulo (TRE-SP)

processos.desfecho: The conviction to 8 years of ineligibility was upheld unanimously by the TRE-SP in August 2026; the TSE has not yet ruled on the appeal.

processos.titulo: PF police investigation into campaign donations and money laundering (2022 election)
processos.objeto: Investigates whether Pablo Marçal made donations to election campaigns in 2022 that were later passed on to companies in which he held an ownership stake, constituting electoral ideological falsehood, electoral misappropriation and money laundering.
processos.resumo: The investigation was opened in 2023, with a police operation in May of that year making Marçal a formal target. The Polícia Federal is still analyzing financial records in order to complete its report; the defense denies any irregularity and describes the police investigation as political persecution. No conclusion of the police investigation was found as of the collection date.
processos.desfecho: It is a Polícia Federal investigation into donations from 2022, with no indictment filed up to the collection; Marçal is not yet a defendant in this case.

processos.titulo: Action at the TSE against the candidacy registration — filing deadline and party switch to the PRTB
processos.objeto: An action brought by Erciley Pires Santana, a candidate for federal deputy for Novo-GO, seeking the annulment of the registration of Pablo Marçal's candidacy for the Presidency, alleging that the filing took place after 7 p.m. on the final deadline (August 15, 2026), the absence of a government plan, and questioning the legality of the court decision that returned Marçal to the PRTB after the departure from União Brasil.
processos.resumo: The reporting justice at the TSE is Estela Aranha. The plaintiff asks that Marçal be notified to present a defense, that the candidacy be annulled and that the Ministério Público investigate irregularities in the party membership registration. Reports from early September 2026 indicate that the TSE had already confirmed eight other presidential candidacies, but that Marçal's was still awaiting a ruling. As of the collection, there is no decision on the merits of the request.
processos.desfecho: A Novo-GO candidate seeks the annulment of Marçal's candidacy over an alleged delay in the registration and an irregularity in the switch to the PRTB; the TSE has not yet ruled.

processos.titulo: Criminal case — expedition to Pico dos Marins with 32 people (art. 132 of the Criminal Code)
processos.objeto: In January 2022, Marçal led 32 mentees up Pico dos Marins (SP), above 2,400 m, in rain, cold and strong winds, against warnings from local guides. The group became stranded and was evacuated in a Fire Department operation that lasted about nine hours. The Ministério Público filed an indictment under art. 132 of the Código Penal — exposing the life or health of another to direct and imminent danger. No one died.
processos.resumo: The São Paulo courts accepted the indictment on May 20, 2025 and made Marçal a defendant. Before that, the case had been investigated under a more serious classification and the court had barred him from carrying out outdoor nature activities without prior authorization from the authorities. According to CNN, a non-prosecution agreement was offered, which required an acknowledgment of responsibility for organizing the hike, and the defense refused it. The case was still ongoing, with no ruling on the merits, on the collection date.
processos.desfecho: Being a defendant means that the accusation was accepted and the case will proceed — it does not mean guilt. There was no trial and no conviction up to the date of this collection. The defense states that there is no evidence that he organized the event, that the testimony points to 'a walk among friends, without any formal organization', and that no one acted with intent.

processos.titulo: Labor lawsuit — death of Celso Guimarães Silva in a workplace accident (company found liable)
processos.tribunal: 5th Labor Court of Barueri · 2nd Panel of the TRT-2 on appeal
processos.objeto: In June 2023, Celso Guimarães Silva, 49, a technician in electrical and audiovisual installations, died after an electric shock and a fall of about 4 meters while dismantling a cinema structure at a studio in Alphaville (SP) for Marçal Participações LTDA. The expert examination pointed to exposed wiring, lack of insulation and the absence of adequate infrastructure for personal protective equipment. The action is a labor lawsuit, brought by the family against the company.
processos.resumo: The 2nd Panel of the TRT-2 unanimously upheld the order to pay about R$ 2.4 million in moral and material damages to the family, and imposed a fine for a delaying appeal. The party held liable is Marçal Participações LTDA, the legal entity in which Pablo Marçal is a partner — not him as an individual. This is the reason the case appears here with a label of its own: it is on the list because it is his company and the death occurred in work performed for it, but the liability recognized is the company's.
processos.desfecho: The one convicted was the company, Marçal Participações LTDA, and not Pablo Marçal as an individual — this is what he himself states, and the sources confirm it. The judgment is a labor one, for compensation to the family, not a criminal one: no court said that there had been a crime. What was recognized at two levels of jurisdiction is that the company was answerable for the working conditions in which the technician died.

processos.titulo: Police investigation — death of Bruno da Silva Teixeira in a street run
processos.tribunal: Polícia Civil of São Paulo — 2nd Police District of Barueri
processos.objeto: On June 5, 2023, Bruno da Silva Teixeira, 26, a service provider for XGrow — a technology company founded by Marçal —, suffered cardiac arrest and died during a street race in Alphaville (Barueri, SP). According to press coverage, the route was extended from 21 km to 42 km on the spot, with no preparation and no prior medical examination of the participants. The police opened a suspicious-death police investigation.
processos.resumo: The IML report, signed by forensic examiner Diogo Crevatin Sheldon, concluded that the death was caused by acute myocardial infarction resulting from excessive exertion, with a negative toxicology test and no external injuries. The family publicly accused the company's leadership of negligence and psychological pressure. In the sources read for this collection, no police indictment, no indictment by the Ministério Público and no criminal case against Pablo Marçal for this case was found, nor any report that the police investigation had been closed — see 'limites'.
processos.desfecho: There was a police investigation, not a court case: no one was formally accused in this matter, and Pablo Marçal is not a defendant in it. The report establishes the cause of death — infarction from excessive exertion —, which is different from establishing anyone's responsibility. Marçal denies having organized or encouraged the event and describes it as amateur, spontaneous training among friends.
processos.obs: This item is here because it is a police investigation into a death that occurred in an activity linked to his company, and not an accusation against him. No confirmation of an outcome in the sources read.

mar.obs: Marçal responde a diversas outras AIJEs e representações eleitorais além das listadas; foram incluídas apenas as que puderam ser confirmadas com número de processo e decisão datada a partir das fontes lidas.

processos.titulo: Indictment for incitement to religious/ethnic discrimination (antisemitism)
processos.tribunal: Federal Court of São Paulo (10th Criminal Court)
processos.objeto: Examines whether Rui Costa Pimenta and fellow PCO leader Henrique Áreas incited religious and ethnic discrimination and prejudice against Jews, following a representation by the Confederação Israelita do Brasil (Conib), by publishing content supporting the destruction of Israel and expressing support for an organization classified as terrorist.
processos.resumo: Federal judge Nathália Luchini accepted the indictment from the Ministério Público Federal on May 14, 2026, making Pimenta and Áreas defendants. The defense argued that the statements were legitimate political expression; the judge rejected that argument, ordering a digital forensic examination to verify the integrity of the evidence and the case to proceed to judgment.
processos.desfecho: The indictment was accepted and Pimenta became a defendant, but the case is still in the evidentiary phase; there was no conviction and no acquittal up to the collection.

processos.titulo: Operação 'Causa Própria' — diversion of party and electoral funds
processos.tribunal: Polícia Federal, by order of the Electoral Court
processos.objeto: Investigates alleged diversion of funds from the Fundo Partidário (party fund) and from the Fundo Especial de Financiamento de Campanha (FEFC) earmarked for the PCO, with evidence of transfers to companies and individuals with no operating capacity compatible with the amounts received and with no proven link to the party.
processos.resumo: On August 11, 2026, the Polícia Federal carried out an operation involving search and seizure, the freezing of accounts and other precautionary measures against Rui Costa Pimenta and other individuals under investigation, on suspicion of misappropriation of electoral funds, forgery of an electoral document and money laundering. Pimenta characterized the action as political persecution, linking it to the proximity of the launch of his own candidacy. As of the collection date, no formal indictment has been filed.
processos.desfecho: It is an investigation with a search and seizure ordered by the Electoral Court; up to the collection, there was no formal indictment against Pimenta.

rui.obs: Há também reportagens sobre condenação cível de Rui Costa Pimenta a indenizar o deputado Kim Kataguiri por dano moral (por tê-lo chamado de 'nazistinha'), com trânsito em julgado noticiado em janeiro de 2025; o item não foi incluído nesta lista por se tratar de ação cível de dano moral entre particulares, sem tribunal superior (STF/STJ/TSE/TRE) envolvido, ainda que amplamente noticiada (Conjur e Poder360). Nesta atualização, buscou-se por AIJEs, representações ou pedidos de cassação/inelegibilidade contra Rui Costa Pimenta além dos dois processos já listados; não foi localizada nenhuma ação eleitoral adicional em tramitação contra ele.

processos.titulo: Indictment for influence peddling (contract at a state-owned media company)
processos.objeto: Investigated whether Renan Santos used political influence to obtain a contract, in favor of a businessman, with a state-owned communications company, in exchange for donations via YouTube.
processos.resumo: The indictment for influence peddling was rejected at first instance in November 2020. The TJ-SP upheld the rejection on November 23, 2021, unanimously, on the grounds that the prosecution did not present sufficient minimum evidence of criminal conduct, despite acknowledging that this is a crime that is difficult to prove.
processos.obs: No second press source with a different editorial orientation covering specifically the rejection of the indictment by the TJ-SP was found within the time frame of this collection (the sources located on this particular episode converge around specialized legal coverage).
processos.desfecho: The indictment was rejected before it became a criminal case, for lack of minimum evidence; there was no ruling on whether Renan Santos committed the crime.

processos.titulo: Police investigation into money laundering (Operação Juno Moneta)
processos.objeto: Investigates whether Renan Santos and family members used shell companies and 'front men' to move funds (including donations over the internet) with no correspondence to their declared income, in a possible money laundering scheme.
processos.resumo: The investigation began with a search and seizure at the MBL's headquarters in July 2020 (Operação Juno Moneta). In March 2022, the Ministério Público de São Paulo obtained judicial authorization to widen the lifting of banking secrecy and examine suspicious donations of more than R$ 1 million received by a company linked to Renan Santos. No formal indictment was found to have been filed as of the collection date.
processos.desfecho: It is an MP-SP investigation into money laundering, with a broadened lifting of secrecy in 2022; no formal indictment was found up to the collection.

processos.titulo: Provisional suspension of the campaign for failure to declare social media profiles
processos.objeto: Examines whether Renan Santos engaged in strategic omission by declaring, twelve days after the registration of the candidacy on August 7, 2026, the 16 profiles maintained on social networks — a requirement of Law 9,504/1997 and TSE Resolution 23,609/2019 —, which could have benefited those accounts with the platforms' algorithms while they presented themselves as ordinary profiles.
processos.resumo: Justice Dias Toffoli, of the TSE, ordered on August 29, 2026 the immediate suspension of Renan Santos's advertising on social media, of the transfers from the Fundo Eleitoral and of his participation in debates, as well as fines in the event of non-compliance. The decision is precautionary and provisional: the candidate had 24 hours to explain himself, and the TSE itself states that he remains registered as a candidate. Renan Santos announced an appeal against the measure.
processos.desfecho: Toffoli provisionally suspended Renan Santos's campaign advertising and Fundo Eleitoral transfers over a delay in declaring social media profiles; it is a provisional decision, and he has already announced an appeal.

processos.titulo: Labor enforcement proceedings — R$ 61,800 blocked in a private pension plan (Farbenplas case)
processos.tribunal: 2nd Labor Court of Betim (MG) · liability ruling at the TRT-3
processos.objeto: Action brought in 2014 by a painter who provided services to Farbenplas Automotiva, in Betim (MG), claiming severance pay, wage differences, overtime, a hazardous-work premium and FGTS deposits. In 2016 the Regional Labor Court of the 3rd Region (TRT-3) held the companies and individuals involved jointly and severally liable, among them Renan Santos. As the debt was not paid, the case moved into enforcement proceedings.
processos.resumo: On August 28, 2026, judge Ordenisio Cesar dos Santos, of the 2nd Labor Court of Betim, ordered the freezing of R$ 61,803.71 in Renan Santos's private pension plans, after other searches for assets had been exhausted, in order to secure payment. It is a measure enforcing an already existing judgment, not a new conviction.
processos.desfecho: It is a labor judgment, not a criminal conviction: what is at issue is a debt owed to a worker, and it has already become final enough to be in enforcement proceedings — hence the freezing. Liability is joint and several, that is, the creditor may collect from any of those held liable. The defense states that he was never formally part of the company's ownership structure, that the inclusion of his name is improper, and said that he would appeal.

processos.titulo: Action to remove from public listing tax debts charged by the PGFN
processos.tribunal: not found in the sources read
processos.objeto: Renan Santos went to court so that tax debts charged against him would stop appearing in a public listing. The charge by the Procuradoria-Geral da Fazenda Nacional totals around R$ 1.17 million.
processos.resumo: The request concerns the publicity of the debt, not its existence. The defense argues that the charge is improper because he was not part of the company on the date the debts were generated. No ruling on the merits was found in the sources read.
processos.desfecho: No court has yet decided whether the debt is his or not. What he requested was that the charge be taken off the public list while the matter is being disputed — which is different from having been acquitted of the debt, and also different from having been ordered to pay it.

processos.titulo: Labor liabilities of the companies linked to Renan Santos and his family
processos.numero: vários processos; números não reunidos nesta coleta
processos.objeto: Press surveys point to an accumulation of labor and civil lawsuits at companies run by Renan Santos or by his family. Martin Artefatos de Metal, in which he acted as managing partner, is reported to have faced at least 45 labor lawsuits, with awards above R$ 1.5 million in the values of the time; a 2016 report spoke of more than 60 cases in total.
processos.resumo: This item is not a case: it is a record of a set of lawsuits reported by the press, at companies — not against the individual in most of them. The figures come from journalistic surveys and were not checked one by one in the court systems in this collection. It appears here because it is the context for the Farbenplas case above, and without it that freezing would look like an isolated episode.
processos.desfecho: These are company debts, and in most of them it is the legal entity that is answerable. The Farbenplas case is the documented exception in which his name was included in the judgment. Renan Santos and the MBL leadership deny structured fraud and attribute the debts to business assets that were already weakened when they were taken over.
processos.obs: Case counts taken from a news report, not checked case by case — see 'limites'.

ren.obs: Não foi possível confirmar, com as fontes lidas, se a investigação sobre lavagem de dinheiro avançou para denúncia formal entre 2022 e a data da coleta; o estado 'em investigação' reflete a última atualização encontrada (março de 2022) e pode estar desatualizado.

processos.titulo: Guarujá triplex
processos.numero: não localizado nesta coleta (ação penal originada na 13ª Vara Federal de Curitiba, depois redistribuída à Justiça Federal do DF)
processos.tribunal: STF / Federal Court of the DF
processos.objeto: Investigated whether Lula received, as an improper benefit from the construction company OAS, a triplex apartment in Guarujá (SP) in exchange for contracts with Petrobras.
processos.resumo: Lula was convicted at first and second instance by the Federal Court of Paraná. In March 2021, the STF (justice Edson Fachin) annulled all acts of the 13th Federal Court of Curitiba for lack of jurisdiction, sending the case to the Federal Court of the Distrito Federal. On January 28, 2022, federal judge Pollyanna Kelly Maciel Martins Alves definitively shelved the case, recognizing the statute of limitations on the right to prosecute, since the milestones that interrupt the limitation period, tied to the annulled acts of Sérgio Moro, ceased to have effect.
processos.desfecho: There was no acquittal: the conviction was annulled in 2021 because the STF found that the Curitiba court lacked jurisdiction, and the case was later terminated under the statute of limitations.

processos.titulo: Atibaia country house
processos.tribunal: Federal Court of the DF (12th Federal Criminal Court of Brasília)
processos.objeto: Investigated whether Lula received, through renovations paid for by the contractors OAS and Odebrecht at a country house in Atibaia (SP), around R$ 1 million in improper benefits in exchange for public contracts.
processos.resumo: Lula was convicted in February 2019 by judge Gabriela Hardt, in Curitiba, with the sentence increased in November of that year. In March 2021, the STF annulled the decisions of the Curitiba court for lack of jurisdiction, sending the case to Brasília. On August 21, 2021, federal judge Pollyanna Kelly Maciel Martins Alves rejected the indictment refiled by the Ministério Público Federal, on the grounds that there was no just cause after the annulment of the evidence produced under Moro's conduct of the case.
processos.desfecho: The conviction was annulled by the STF for lack of jurisdiction of the Curitiba court, and the Brasília judge rejected the re-filed indictment for lack of valid evidence.

processos.titulo: Operação Zelotes — Medida Provisória 471
processos.tribunal: Federal Court of the DF (10th Federal Criminal Court of Brasília)
processos.objeto: Investigated whether Lula received an offer of R$ 6 million in bribes from vehicle manufacturers in exchange for issuing Medida Provisória 471, which extended tax incentives to the automotive sector.
processos.resumo: Lula became a defendant in the case in September 2017, in the context of Operação Zelotes. On June 21, 2021, federal judge Frederico Botelho de Barros Viana, of the 10th Federal Court of Brasília, acquitted Lula, following the opinion of the Ministério Público Federal that the evidence about the existence and the form of the transfer of the R$ 6 million was insufficient.
processos.desfecho: There was a ruling on the merits: the federal judge acquitted Lula for lack of evidence on the transfer of the bribe, following the opinion of the Ministério Público.

processos.titulo: Operação Zelotes — purchase of the Gripen fighter jets
processos.objeto: Investigates alleged influence peddling by Lula with then-president Dilma Rousseff in the decision on the purchase of the Swedish Gripen fighter jets by the Brazilian Air Force, within Operação Zelotes.
processos.resumo: The case, a remnant of Operação Zelotes after Moro's acts were annulled, was suspended by the STF in March 2022 because of an incidental question about the conduct of the evidentiary phase. Up to the date of the collection, no ruling on the merits was found.
processos.obs: The two sources located for this item have a similar editorial orientation (center); no coverage of the same fact in an outlet of a different orientation was found within the time frame of this collection.
processos.desfecho: The case has been suspended since 2022 over an incidental question about the evidentiary phase; up to the collection, there had been no ruling on the alleged influence peddling.

processos.titulo: AIJE — tribute at the carnival parade of the Acadêmicos de Niterói
processos.objeto: Electoral investigation action (AIJE) brought by the Novo party examining whether about R$ 9.6 million in public funds from Niterói, from the state of Rio de Janeiro and from Embratur were used to pay for a tribute to Lula in the samba theme song of the Acadêmicos de Niterói school at the 2026 carnival, and whether his exposure during the broadcast of the parade amounted to improper use of the media outside the electoral advertising period.
processos.resumo: Justice Antonio Carlos Ferreira admitted the action on August 26, 2026, finding that the initial petition met the admissibility requirements. Novo asks for the revocation of the Lula-Alckmin ticket. As of the collection date there was no decision on the merits of the accusation of abuse of political power or improper use of the media.
processos.desfecho: The Novo seeks the revocation of the Lula-Alckmin ticket over the alleged use of public money in a carnival tribute; the TSE admitted the action, but there is still no decision on the merits.

lul.obs: Lula foi parte em dezenas de ações e inquéritos ligados à Operação Lava Jato e à Operação Zelotes ao longo de 2016-2021; a maioria foi anulada, suspensa ou arquivada após o STF reconhecer, em março de 2021, a incompetência da 13ª Vara Federal de Curitiba e a suspeição do juiz Sérgio Moro. Esta lista traz os quatro casos que puderam ser individualmente confirmados, com datas e decisões específicas, a partir das fontes lidas nesta coleta; outros processos remanescentes (ex.: caso Instituto Lula/Odebrecht, caso Equatorial Guinea, caso BNDES/Odebrecht) foram identificados em buscas, mas não puderam ser verificados com o mesmo grau de detalhe dentro do tempo desta coleta.

processos.titulo: Indictment for slander against justice Gilmar Mendes
processos.objeto: Examines whether Romeu Zema committed slander against STF Justice Gilmar Mendes by publishing, on his own social networks, a series of satirical videos ('Os intocáveis') that would attribute to STF justices criminal conduct (passive corruption) associated with the Banco Master case.
processos.resumo: The Procuradoria-Geral da República filed an indictment against Zema at the STJ on May 15, 2026, on the grounds that he falsely attributed the commission of a crime to Gilmar Mendes by publishing the satirical videos, using institutional and political profiles. As of the collection date, no reporting justice had been assigned and there was no decision on whether the indictment would be accepted.
processos.desfecho: The PGR filed an indictment against Zema, but the STJ has not yet decided whether to accept it; there is no assigned reporting justice and no judgment up to the date of the collection.

processos.titulo: Request for inclusion in the Fake News police investigation
processos.objeto: Request by justice Gilmar Mendes to the reporting justice, Alexandre de Moraes, to include Romeu Zema as a subject of investigation in the Fake News police investigation, because of the posting of the satirical videos about STF justices.
processos.resumo: After Zema published the videos in April 2026, Gilmar Mendes formally asked Moraes to include the former governor among those under investigation in the police investigation. As of the collection date, the sources consulted indicate that the request was awaiting a statement from the PGR and a decision by Moraes, with no confirmation that Zema has been formally included as a person under investigation in the police investigation; for that reason the status is recorded as not confirmed.
processos.desfecho: It is only a request by Gilmar Mendes to include Zema in the police investigation; the sources do not confirm that he has been formally included as a subject of investigation.

zem.obs: Reportagens de 2021 mencionaram 'procedimentos preliminares' no STJ sobre a compra de respiradores e a montagem de hospital de campanha no Expominas (MG) durante a pandemia de Covid-19, citando Zema entre governadores relacionados pela PGR a uma CPI; não foi encontrada confirmação de que esses procedimentos preliminares tenham se transformado em inquérito formal contra Zema pessoalmente, por isso o item não foi incluído nesta lista. Nesta atualização, buscou-se por AIJEs, representações ou pedidos de cassação/inelegibilidade contra Romeu Zema além dos dois processos já listados; não foi localizada nenhuma ação eleitoral adicional em tramitação contra ele.

processos.titulo: Fine for bad-faith litigation — request to invalidate ballot boxes of the 2022 runoff
processos.objeto: The PL asked the TSE to invalidate the votes of more than half of the electronic voting machines used in the second round of the 2022 presidential election (279,000 of 472,000 machines), alleging irregularities in the equipment's records ('logs'), without contesting the machines that had elected the party's own federal deputies and senators.
processos.status: multa mantida em julgamento de recurso
processos.resumo: The reporting justice, Alexandre de Moraes, described the request as 'abusive' and made in bad faith, because it sought to reverse the result of the election without questioning the voting machines that had benefited the PL itself. The TSE imposed a fine on the party; on December 15, 2022, the TSE plenary rejected by majority (five votes to one, with a partial dissent by justice Raul Araújo only as to the amount) the PL's appeal against the fine and the freezing of the party's accounts.
processos.desfecho: The TSE fined the PL R$ 22.9 million for seeking the annulment of votes from half the ballot boxes of the 2022 runoff without challenging the boxes that elected the party's own lawmakers; the appeal has already been rejected.

processos.titulo: Conviction for gender-quota fraud — fictitious candidate in Afuá (PA)
processos.objeto: Investigates whether the PSD fielded, in the municipality of Afuá (PA), a fictitious city council candidate solely to meet the minimum gender quota required by law (between 30% and 70% of candidacies of each sex), without her having campaigned on her own behalf.
processos.resumo: The TSE found that the PSD candidate in Afuá campaigned only for her husband, with no campaign activity of her own and no votes, and identified standardized campaign finance reports with a low volume of funds as an indication of fraud. Unanimously, following the vote of the reporting justice, Benedito Gonçalves, the court revoked the candidate's certificate of election, annulled the PSD's votes for city councilor in Afuá, ordered a recount of the electoral and party quotients and decreed 8 years of ineligibility for the candidate. In the same judgment, the decision also convicted Republicanos (in Macau/RN) and PSDB (in Governador Nunes Freire/MA) for similar frauds.
processos.desfecho: The TSE revoked the registration of the PSD candidate in Afuá (PA) for gender-quota fraud — she campaigned only for her husband — and imposed 8 years of ineligibility, unanimously.
processos.obs: No second press source covering specifically the PSD case in Afuá was found within the time frame of this collection; the official source (Agência Brasil) carries the full text of the TSE decision.

processos.titulo: Accounts rejected — Fundo Partidário Mulher money used for legal fees (Rondônia)
processos.objeto: Examines whether the Avante state branch in Rondônia failed to restore, after the judicial unfreezing in November 2024, a specific Fundo Partidário Mulher account (intended to promote women's political participation) and used the corresponding R$ 10,990.50, together with the ordinary account, to pay legal fees — including a payment of R$ 5,940 made twice to a law firm.
processos.resumo: Unanimously, at the 42nd Ordinary Session of June 17, 2026, the TRE-RO ordered Avante to pay R$ 16,930.50 to the Tesouro Nacional, with an additional 10% fine, as well as a deduction from its Fundo Partidário quotas over the following 12 months. The report consulted does not explicitly mention whether an appeal is available against this specific decision.
processos.desfecho: The TRE-RO rejected the Avante's accounts for failing to replenish an account earmarked for women and for duplicate payment to lawyers; the party must return R$ 16,930.50 with a 10% fine.
processos.obs: No second press source covering specifically this TRE-RO ruling was found within the time frame of this collection; the report consulted cites the number of the ruling and the date of the judgment session.

processos.titulo: 2019 accounts rejected — funds from a source barred by law (Mauá City Council)
processos.objeto: Examines whether the Avante state branch in São Paulo received funds from a source prohibited by law (the Mauá City Council) in its 2019 accounts, in addition to other irregularities such as the lack of a complete bank statement and the absence of proof of the origin of donations.
processos.resumo: The TRE-SP identified irregularities totaling R$ 98,777.66 (135.84% of the financial movement for the year) and ordered Avante-SP to pay R$ 61,221.11 back to the public treasury, in addition to being subject to suspension of Fundo Partidário transfers for at least one year. An electoral law specialist consulted by the report said that the courts will only act once the decision is final and unappealable, since an appeal to the TSE is available.
processos.desfecho: The TRE-SP rejected the Avante-SP's 2019 accounts for receiving barred funds from a City Council; the party must return R$ 61,221.11 and an appeal to the TSE is still available.
processos.obs: No second press source covering specifically this TRE-SP decision on the Avante-SP's 2019 accounts was found within the time frame of this collection.

processos.titulo: 2018 accounts rejected — Fundo Partidário (party fund) transfer with an earlier unresolved issue
processos.objeto: Investigates whether the PRTB's state branch in São Paulo improperly received R$ 234,000 from the Fundo Partidário (party fund) in 2018, despite an unresolved issue in its 2012-2013 accounts, in addition to R$ 2,400 in headquarters rent expenses without adequate proof.
processos.resumo: The TRE-SP unanimously rejected the PRTB's 2018 accounts, on the grounds that Fundo Partidário transfers should have remained suspended while the 2012-2013 pending matter was unresolved. The party was ordered to return R$ 236,400 to the Tesouro Nacional, with a 4% adjustment, and Fundo Partidário transfers remain suspended until payment. The decision is subject to appeal.
processos.desfecho: The TRE-SP rejected the PRTB's 2018 accounts for receiving a Fundo Partidário (party fund) transfer with an earlier unresolved issue; the party must return R$ 236,400, and an appeal is available.

fonte.nome: Tribunal Regional Eleitoral de São Paulo (TRE-SP)

processos.obs: No second press source covering specifically this decision on the PRTB-SP's 2018 accounts was found within the time frame of this collection; the source is the TRE-SP's official page.

processos.titulo: Suspension of social media profiles and coercive fine — posts against STF and TSE justices
processos.objeto: Examines whether posts made on the PCO's official social media profiles, with terms such as calling a justice a 'skinhead in robes' and describing the STF as 'undemocratic', amounted to an attack on the institutional order, in the context of the Inquérito das Fake News conducted by justice Alexandre de Moraes.
processos.status: contas suspensas e depois restabelecidas, com multa cominatória
processos.resumo: On January 11, 2023, Moraes ordered the removal of the PCO's official profiles from X/Twitter, Instagram, Telegram, Facebook, YouTube and TikTok, citing a serious violation of the legal order on the basis of nine highlighted posts. On February 28, 2023, 48 days later, he authorized the reactivation of the accounts, taking the view that the attacks had ceased, but set a coercive fine of R$ 10,000 in the event of a new post with the same content. This is a single-justice, precautionary decision; no ruling on the merits regarding the content of the posts was found in the sources of this collection.
processos.desfecho: Moraes suspended the PCO's official social media profiles for about 40 days over attacks on STF and TSE justices, within the fake news police investigation, with a coercive fine in case of a further repeat.
processos.obs: No second press source covering specifically the reactivation of the PCO's accounts and the coercive fine set by Moraes was found within the time frame of this collection.

processos.titulo: PF police investigation into Flávio Bolsonaro's fraudulent membership in the party
processos.tribunal: Polícia Federal, by order of the TSE
processos.objeto: Examines whether Flávio Bolsonaro's membership in Missão — which blocked the registration of his candidacy for the Presidency on the PL ticket, by flagging him as a member of another party — originated from inside Missão's own structure, using a fictitious CPF and the senator's institutional email at the Senate.
processos.resumo: The TSE, after ruling out the hypothesis of an external intrusion into the system, found that the fraudulent party membership registration was made with the Missão party's own credentials. The president of the TSE, justice Kássio Nunes Marques, ordered a referral to the Procuradoria-Geral Eleitoral and the opening of a police investigation by the Polícia Federal on August 18, 2026. Missão denies institutional involvement and presents itself as a victim of the fraud, having submitted to the investigation the IP address of whoever made the registration and records showing that the notices sent to Flávio Bolsonaro were opened but not answered. As of the collection, there is no formal indictment against the party.
processos.desfecho: The TSE found that Flávio Bolsonaro's fraudulent membership originated inside the Missão and requested a police investigation from the PF; the party denies involvement, and no one had been indicted up to the collection.

processos.titulo: Operação Poço de Lobato (Refit) — the person investigated is one of the party's largest donors
processos.tribunal: Receita Federal and Ministério Público de São Paulo
processos.objeto: The operation is investigating a billion-real scheme of tax evasion and money laundering attributed to the Refit group, formerly Refinaria de Manguinhos. Among those under investigation is Cristiano Moreira Pinto Beraldo, then a leader of the MBL, identified as responsible for the use of offshore companies. In a live broadcast, Arthur do Val stated that he and Beraldo were the largest donors to Missão; asked about it later, he said that Beraldo's donations do not reach 4% of the total raised. Beraldo stepped away from the MBL when he became a target of the operation.
processos.resumo: Recorded here because of the party's financing, not because of any accusation against it. Members of the MBL, Renan Santos among them, appear at events sponsored by Refit — the company's 70th anniversary party in December 2024, a carnival box in 2025 and a forum in the United States in May 2025. The report that brought the case to light states expressly that Renan Santos is not under investigation in the operation, and no commercial link between him and Refit is identified.
processos.conclusao: não é processo contra o partido nem contra o candidato
processos.desfecho: No one from the party is a defendant or under investigation in this operation. What exists is one donor among those under investigation and the presence of leaders at events paid for by the company. The MBL denies any institutional relationship: 'There is no relationship at all between the MBL and Refit, what one see is us going to a lot of events', says spokesman Arthur do Val, who cites votes and committee reports by Kim Kataguiri against the sector's interests.

processos.titulo: Action on the calculation of the 2026 Fundo Eleitoral, withdrawn by the party itself
processos.inicio: não localizado nesta coleta (anterior a agosto de 2026)
processos.objeto: The PT itself had asked the TSE to review the calculation method used to distribute the 2026 Fundo Especial de Financiamento de Campanha (FEFC) among the parties.
processos.status: processo extinto a pedido do autor
processos.resumo: On August 18, 2026, the TSE plenary granted the PT's own request to withdraw the action and ordered the case terminated with no ruling on the merits. The decision unblocked the release of R$ 2.3 billion in withheld Fundo Eleitoral funds, distributed in proportion to each party's representation in Congress. This is not a case brought against the party, but an action that the PT itself withdrew.
processos.desfecho: The PT asked the TSE to review the calculation of the 2026 Fundo Eleitoral and then withdrew its own request; the TSE terminated the case with no ruling on the merits and released the funds that had been withheld.
processos.obs: This item records an action in which the PT was the plaintiff, not the defendant; it was included because it directly involves the party's use of the Fundo Eleitoral, one of the topics requested in this collection. No second press source covering this withdrawal specifically was found within the time frame of this collection.

NOVO.obs: Buscou-se especificamente por prestação de contas rejeitada, multas, uso questionado do Fundo Partidário/Eleitoral, ações sobre cotas de gênero/raça e pedidos de cassação de registro envolvendo o Partido Novo como parte; não foi localizado, dentro dos limites desta coleta (WebSearch/WebFetch), nenhum processo dessa natureza contra a legenda nacional. Foi encontrada apenas uma notícia de 2022 sobre o partido comunicar ao TSE a renúncia voluntária a recursos do Fundo Eleitoral, o que não é um processo.
